SELECT SUM(a.device_num) AS device_num,SUM(a.dev_online_num) AS dev_online_num,
FROM vm_statistics_devices a
YEAR = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now()) AND MONTH = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM now()) AND DAY = EXTRACT(DAY FROM now()) ${dataScope}
AND a.province_id = #{provinceId} GROUP BY a.city_id
AND a.city_id = #{cityId} GROUP BY a.county_id
AND a.province_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.province_id

SELECT SUM(a.today_all) AS todayAll,sum(a.today_complete) AS todayComplete,SUM(a.judge_num) AS judge_num,SUM(a.dispatch_num) AS dispatch_num, SUM(a.grab_num) AS grab_num,SUM(a.handle_num) AS handle_num, SUM(a.approve_num) AS approve_num,SUM(a.order_complete_num) AS order_complete_num, SUM(a.false_complete_num) AS false_complete_num, SUM(a.repeat_complete_num) AS repeat_complete_num, SUM(a.acceptance_num) AS acceptance_num,
FROM vm_statistics_event_num_day a

SELECT a.AREA_CODE,a.AREA_NAME,a.LONGITUDE,a.LATITUDE FROM sys_area a WHERE a.AREA_CODE IN
#{item}

SELECT
dataTable.sub_scene_code as 'typeId',
dataTable.warning_type_id as 'typeId',
date_format(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as eventDate,SUM(dataTable.warning_num) as num FROM
vm_statistics_event_sub_scene dataTable
vm_statistics_event_type dataTable
AND dataTable.create_date >= #{startTime} AND dataTable.create_date <= #{endTime}
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{areaCode} or dataTable.province_id = #{areaCode} or dataTable.city_id = #{areaCode})
${dataScope}
GROUP BY
dataTable.sub_scene_code
dataTable.warning_type_id
,date_format(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d')
